headline: Coordination is not the same as legitimate action.
lede: Frameworks can spawn agents, route work, and persist execution state. Ateles is designed around the questions those mechanisms leave open: who was entitled to act, under whose authority, against which state, and how the result can be reviewed.

items.title: Read the foundation
items.body: See the charter, authority model, work model, planning model, and the status that distinguishes design from current execution.

items.title: Inspect the comparison
items.body: Review the source-backed incumbent and competitor test, including where competing systems are stronger and where the boundary still holds.
